title: Bow To the Lord, By His Command - Bow to whom?
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Sultaan Allah
Subhaanallah, SULTAANALLAH!! Subhaanallah, SULTAANALLAH!!
Allahuma salli `alaa Sayyidina Muhammadan nabiyyi 'l-ummiyy wa `alaa aalihi wa Saahbihi wa sallam. Yaa
Rabbee zid habeebaka `izzan wa sharafan wa nooran wa surooran wa ridwaanan wa sultaana. Anta Sultaan li'
l-khalaaiqu jamiyy`an yaa Rabbana, yaa Rabbi 'ghfir wa 'rham wa anta khayru 'r-Raahimeen. Thumma 'ssalaamu `alayka, yaa Saahibu 'z-Zamaan. Thumma 's-salaamu `alayka yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa’lAkhireen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad, madad yaa RijaalAllah. Madad yaa Saahibu 'z-Zamaan. Madad yaa Sultaanu 'l-Awliyaa.
As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh. They are saying, a`oodhu billahi mina 'sh-Shaytan arhttp://www.sufismus-online.de/BowToTheLord (1 von 6)04.07.2013 23:08:22

rajeem. Bismillahi Rahman ar-Raheem; it must be. Now I am not in myself. My will and my whole being is
under the holy arranging through heavenly people on Earth. Therefore, what I am saying is not from me but
what is sent to me. I am only speaking; I don't know anything, I am only a transmitter. That is something
from the Day of Promises, when Allah Almighty is saying (Mawlana Shaykh stands) nahnu qasamna, “We
say: By Allah!" (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O our `ulamas, teachers! We are beginning and saying, a`oodhu billahi minash Shaytan ar-rajeem, running
away from Shaytan and its soldiers. I am running away and all of you must run away, and don't leave it to
come closer to you. Don't make friendship with Shaytan. The worst friendship a person may make is
friendship to Shaytan and its followers! And we are saying, Bismillahi Rahman ar-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) Bismillahi Rahman ar-Raheem! O our Lord, You granted us such an endless treasury from preEternal to Eternal. We are bowing to you from pre-Eternal to Eternal, O our Lord! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
O People! O people, don't do ruk`oo, don't bow yourself to anyone except Allah Almighty, yes.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Perhaps also tonight there is coming another bombarding on all `ulamas claiming to be
Salafi, or not to be Wahabi teachers! From east to west, from far east to far west, all over the world this is a
sharpened sword! The Lord of Heavens is ordering, "Bow only to the Lord of Heavens!" and we are doing.
(Mawlana Shaykh bows in ruk`oo.)
O `ulamas, (...) I am never hearing you say, "O our listeners, O our people, O our Muslims! Stand up and bow
to your Lord Almighty!” (Mawlana Shaykh stands and bows.) Allahu akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) You are
saying this? I am asking. This is what they are saying to me, and that is what only I am asking to you. You are
understanding Arabic, and you must be much more, your understanding horizon must be so wide. You are
saying that in the Holy Qur'an you are finding in 14 places to bow. Mashaa-Allah, you are such `ulama,
learned people. What does it mean if Allah Almighty is making 14 places where you must bow? That means
that even for every holy verse you can do one bowing. How many holy verses are in the entire Holy Qur'an?
You must know it. 4,444. Yes? That showing 16: 4,4,4,4 if you are calculating, it is going to be 16. Fourteen in
Holy Qur'an; one at the beginning you must make sajdah to Who sent us the Holy Qur'an and you must do
when you are finishing, khatm, completion, making 16.

From where we are bringing (this knowledge)? I don't know; it is coming to me. I am not preparing
something to address people, no. I am a finished person. But as you know, O `ulamas, kullun muyassarun
lima khuliqa lah, “Everyone is created for what he has been created.” Everyone is suitable for his heavenly
identity, because everyone has been made responsible with something. When everyone leaves Mankind, they
all look at adhamatu 'l-Haqq, the Absolute, Glorious Greatness.
O those claiming they are doctors, or saying, "We are `ulamas." That is a reality that perhaps is never coming
to your minds because it is not from a mindly production. Such things belongs to the heart of the Seal of
Prophets (s), and hearts are an unknown piece of Mankind, impossible to know except who is saying,
•• ••••• ••••• ••• •••• •••• ••••• ••• •••• ••••••
Maa wasi`anee samawaaee wa laa ardi innama wasia`nee qalbee `abdee 'l-mu'min, Heavens and Earth could
not contain Me, but the heart of My believer contains Me.
You must know it if you are `ulamas. That means no one is knowing the real identity of the heart. That means
everyone from Mankind has a special personality, as Allah Almighty is never making two persons from
Mankind to be the same in existence; each one has a special personality. That means the identity of everyone
from Mankind is 100% different!
Is anything wrong, `ulamas? This is `azheem, glorifying our Lord! You must say yes, as only a reminder.
Don't think we are knowing; no, what they are saying, only I am transmitting to you. Are you accepting? Why
they are not accepting? Because their hearts just closed down, locked down and therefore, they are not
listening. Open your hearts and you shall find another, another, another ocean for understanding! In every
one there is a special identity. Allah! Special. That is showing adhaamatu 'l-Haqq, Glorified Greatness of
Allah Almighty! Therefore, saying this through your hearts, I am granting to you. From where coming? From
Him (swt) coming, and through Him there is some relationship without means.
The Lord of Heavens, the Creator of Mankind, is sometimes using for His servants, to make them understand
through prophets. But prophets are not in need of a means; they have means from heavenly beings to earthly
material beings. That must be, because without that means we may burn! This lamp is running on electricity,
but without wires (to conduct the electricity), if you touch it, it is taking you away (you will die). Therefore,
we are using (these wires). And from heavenly beings, from heavens all of them have a special creation

prepared, not to be touched by this power and their physical being destroyed. Now they are coming through
Archangel Gabriel (a). He is taking wires from heavens to the heart of the Seal of Prophets (s). Without his
coming, there can't be anyone here from the special beings of heavens for the special people on Earth.
Holy command. Are you saying, O `ulama, "O people, when you are hearing or reciting Holy Qur'an, you are
coming in touch with a heavenly declaration to bow." (Mawlana Shaykh bows.) To bow! BOW!! To bow is
only for Allah jala jalaalahu. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina Muhammad,
Rasoolullah, Habeebullah, Nooru `Arshillah (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
So many secrets through the holy command, "Bow! Bow!" To whom? To that One Who created you, bow to
Him!" (Mawlana Shaykh bows.) Teach people not to bow to just anything! Salafi `ulama, Shafi'i `ulama,
Qadiri `ulama, in this Islamic world, why you are not teaching people to bow? Yes, you are mostly people
praying and bowing and making sajdah, but we must try to make them understand for what we are bowing
and to Whom! Allah Almighty is saying, Wa dhakkir, “Remind Them!”
O `ulamas, look east and west. Who is the worst friend of people? Say! Say by Allah's command! Say!
Mankind, to whom they are bowing? Ask them. 24, to whom bowing, to whom working, to whom serving, this
Mankind? You taught them, Muslim scholars, Christian scholars, Jewish scholars. Did you teach them to bow
to Allah Almighty only? No, bowing for dunya. Ad-dunya djeefa, this life, this world is dirty! You must try to
take away from the dirtiness of this world, because people are just like pikan?? (Mawlana Shaykh gestures
like a plane coming down). People now are asking from far distance to come and leave that dirtiness. Why
you are not preventing dirtiness, in 24 hours? What all of us are doing?
Are you are bowing to Allah Almighty? Don't think that bowing is only through praying, no. In 24 hours, you
must bow by holy command to the Lord of Heavens.
Heavenly declaration from the first prophet to Sayyidina Muhammad (Mawlana Shaykh stands), the Seal of
Prophets (s), that he delivered the whole Truth (Mawlana Shaykh sits.).
O People! O `ulamas! We are not fearing the Day of Resurrection, when Allah Almighty is going to ask you to

where you were directing people, to dunya? Or going to ask why we are not teaching to where you must direct
yourselves, why you are bowing to dunya and everything in it? To the end of world, the Seal of Prophets (s)
was saying to make sajdah. And you are saying, "We are `ulamas, we are doctors." One meaning I am giving
to you; if you are saying that I am giving a wrong meaning, then you may say we are wrong about signs of
Yawmu 'l-Qiyyamah, and what they may say at that time from the Seal of Prophets (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits.)
O `ulamas! You may think on it. On the Last Days, where is the ummah's qiblah? Muslims are turning to
Ka`aba, (but others), •••••• ••••••• qiblatahum nisa'ahum, “Their prayer direction is their women.” What you
think, Wahabi `ulamas, is the shaykh is saying wrong? You are saying, “The shaykh is saying something I
never heard of,” but yes, the shaykh is saying something to address the whole Earth, and it is something I am
never knowing before now.
Marhaban! There is a flute from bamboo. There are two kinds: bamboo for sugar (sugar cane) and the second
kind it is empty. Empty bamboo is for flutes, but sugar cane can't be, no. I am such a person that I am for
flute, I am shouting, but full one you must give what you have for yourself for sweetness and pleasure and
lights, you must give to people, you must give for people to taste from Holy Qur'an! Who is reciting Holy
Qur'an and getting in pleasure, look from around the world how many people are getting pleasure from Holy
Qur'an? But all people run after the empty bamboo cane, the flutes, all of them. Why you are not directing
people to say, “Your life is not a good life because you are against Shari`atullah. We are not good servants."
Why you are not saying? Say up to the end!
O People! Don't fear, for if Allah Almighty protects a person, all nations can't do anything to that one. But if
Allah Almighty asks to give to Nimrod one mosquito, it is enough! May Allah forgives us.
O People! We must try to bow to Allah (swt) only and every one that represents the Lord of Heavens on
Earth, we may bow to them. The worst one to bow to is Shaytan, next is dunya, then hawaa, endless desires,
and your ego. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Fatihah.
Alhamdulillah wa 'sh-shukrulillah, alhamdulillah wa 'sh-shukrulillah, astaghfirullah!

(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
